maddeler.e: اِسْتَجَنَّ • (istajanna) X (non-past يَسْتَجِنُّ (yastajinnu), verbal noun اِسْتِجْنَان (istijnān))
g: to be covered, to be veiled, to be concealed, to disappear, to become obscured
to vanish, to become cloaked, to be in disguise, to cover oneself
to regard as crazy, to think someone mad
